title: CoSAI Risk Map to FedRAMP Consolidated Rules 2026 (CR-26) Authoritative Crosswalk

provenance.non_invention_notice: Five 20x Key Security Indicators (KSI-CNA-EIS, KSI-MLA-ALA, KSI-SVC-PRR, KSI-SVC-RUD, KSI-SVC-VCM) and FRR rule VDR-TFR-MVX omit Class D variants in CR-26 version 2026.11.02.01 because 20x Class D requirements are scheduled for the 2027 Phase 4 Pilot (see SDR-CSX-KMT). No Class D 20x statements are invented for those entries; Class D enforcement relies on common FRR rules and Rev5 High CTL requirements.

class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_c: SHOULD use active CMVP FIPS-validated modules (SDR rationale required if non-validated).
class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_d: MUST use active CMVP FIPS-validated cryptographic modules across all federal data protection boundaries.

class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_c: MAY supply per-service FedRAMP Certification materials.
class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_d: MUST supply per-service FedRAMP Certification materials.

class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_c: NIST Digital Identity Guidelines IAL2/AAL2/FAL2 + XML-Encryption (SAML) or JWE (OIDC) assertions.
class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_d: NIST Digital Identity Guidelines IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 + XML-Encryption (SAML) or JWE (OIDC) assertions.

class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_c: Document external service locations for all federal customer data.
class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_d: All information processing, federal customer data, and system services MUST remain within U.S./U.S. Territories or geographic locations under U.S. jurisdiction.

class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_c: Evaluate within <= 5 days (VER-TFR-EVU); PAIN=5 IRV+LEV mitigated within 2 days (VDR-TFR-PVR); non-IRV PAIN=5 LEV incident treatment is MAY (VER-TFR-NRI).
class_c_vs_d_key_elevations.class_d: Evaluate within <= 2 days (VER-TFR-EVU); PAIN=5 IRV+LEV mitigated within 12 hours (VDR-TFR-PVR); non-IRV PAIN=5 LEV incident treatment elevates to SHOULD (VER-TFR-NRI).

components.title: Data Sources
components.adr030_decision: Baseline Data Tier
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D mandates U.S./U.S. Territories/U.S. jurisdiction residency for all federal customer data sources and processing (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Data Filtering and Processing
components.adr030_decision: Baseline Data Tier
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D requires FIPS-validated modules (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST vs Class C SHOULD); note KSI-SVC-RUD defines Class B/C only in 2026.11.02.01 (20x Class D pending 2027).

components.title: Training Data
components.adr030_decision: D11 (Training Tier Reachability)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Federal Customer Data MUST NOT enter shared/unscoped training corpora; Class D enforces strict U.S. jurisdiction residency (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Data Storage Infrastructure
components.adr030_decision: D15 (Storage Separation vs Audit Repository)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class C SHOULD vs Class D MUST use active FIPS-validated cryptographic modules at rest (CMU-CSO-UVM); Class D enforces U.S. jurisdiction storage (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Model Frameworks and Code
components.adr030_decision: Baseline Model Training Tier
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Vulnerability evaluation SLA tightens from <= 5 days (Class C) to <= 2 days (Class D) under VER-TFR-EVU; Class D SHOULD escalate non-internet-reachable PAIN=5 LEVs as incidents (VER-TFR-NRI).

components.title: Model Evaluation
components.adr030_decision: D11 (Evaluation Consumes Model Artifact)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Both Class C and Class D MUST run automated KSI validation in 20x (FRC-CSX-VVK) and supply per-service certification artifacts in Class D (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST vs Class C MAY).

components.title: Training and Tuning
components.adr030_decision: D11 (Sole Non-Serving Producer of Model Artifact)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Fine-tuning on Federal Customer Data triggers MAS inclusion and Class D U.S.-jurisdiction compute constraints (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Model Storage
components.adr030_decision: D3, D11 (Deployment Substrate Reaching Serving, Not Artifact)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D MUST encrypt stored model weights/adapters with active FIPS-validated modules (CMU-CSO-UVM) within U.S. jurisdiction (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Model Serving Infrastructure & Policy Enforcement Point
components.adr030_decision: D11, D12 (Sole Runtime Door & Model-Tier Policy Enforcement Point)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D enforces U.S.-jurisdiction-only inference processing (CTL.SA.SA-09-05) and mandatory FIPS 140-3 mTLS termination (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST); note KSI-SVC-VCM omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01.

components.title: Model Registry and Marketplace
components.adr030_decision: D1, D11, D12 (Infrastructure Registry Consulted by Model Serving PEP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Swapping registered foundation models or quantization/adapter digests requires SCN evaluation (SCN-CSO-EVA) and Class D per-service artifact updates (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

components.title: The Model
components.adr030_decision: D11 (Strict Reachability Boundary: Training & Serving Only)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Direct consumer-tier edges to the model artifact are prohibited in both classes (model_reachability_pep=true); Class D mandates U.S. residency for hosted weights (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Application
components.adr030_decision: D6, D8 (Hosted on Runtime Hosting; No Direct Tool Invocation)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D requires per-service certification materials (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST vs Class C MAY) and IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 user authentication (CTL.IA.IA-05).

components.title: Application Output Handling
components.adr030_decision: D7, D11 (Application Outbound Rendering Sanitization)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Prevents markdown/HTML exfiltration beacons from leaking Federal Customer Data; breach impact escalates to High/PAIN=5 faster in Class D (IEC-CSO-EFR).

components.title: Application Input Handling
components.adr030_decision: D7, D11 (Application In-Flow Validation Layer)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Same structural input validation mandate across Class C and Class D; KSI-SVC-VCM defines Class B/C in 2026.11.02.01 (Class D Rev5 relies on CTL.SC.SC-07 / CTL.SI.SI-04).

components.title: Agent Reasoning Core
components.adr030_decision: D6, D8 (Decoupled from Orchestration; Gated by Agent I/O Handling)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Enforces bounded turn/token loops in both classes; Class D requires per-service certification documentation covering reasoning-core autonomy boundaries (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

components.title: Orchestration Output Handling
components.adr030_decision: D4, D8 (Model-Side Orchestration Output Gate)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Validates retrieved/memory-augmented model outputs prior to returning across Model Serving PEP.

components.title: Orchestration Input Handling
components.adr030_decision: D4, D8, D14 (Model-Side Orchestration Input Gate; No Direct Tool Registry Bypass)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Operates behind Model Serving PEP under single model-operator authority in both Class C and Class D.

components.title: External Tool Capabilities
components.adr030_decision: D1 (External Tool Capabilities: Executable Tools & Retrievable Resources)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Explicitly enumerated in allowed_tools (CTL.AC.AC-06-08 software/capability allowlisting); adding side-effecting external tools triggers SCN evaluation (SCN-CSO-EVA).

components.title: Tool Registry and Discovery
components.adr030_decision: D1, D14 (Infrastructure Tool Catalog Consulted by Agent Network PEP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Cryptographically pinned allowlist consulted at connection admission by Agent Network PEP (ADR-030 D14); mandatory true in both Class C and Class D.

components.title: Model Memory
components.adr030_decision: D8 (Orchestration Memory Subgraph Behind Model Serving)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Tenant-partitioned session/long-term memory encrypted via FIPS modules (Class D MUST under CMU-CSO-UVM) within U.S. jurisdiction (Class D CTL.SA.SA-09-05); note KSI-SVC-PRR and KSI-SVC-RUD omit Class D in 2026.11.02.01.

components.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation & Content
components.adr030_decision: D8 (Orchestration Retrieval Subgraph Behind Model Serving)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Enforces document-level ACLs at retrieval time; external vector stores are TPIRs (MAS-CSO-TPR) requiring U.S. residency and FIPS 140-3 encryption in Class D.

components.title: Agent User Query
components.adr030_decision: Baseline Agent Input Primitive
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: User queries in runtime-cso agents constitute Federal Customer Data (FRD-FCD); Class D restricts all processing and caching to U.S. jurisdiction (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Agent System Instructions
components.adr030_decision: Baseline Agent Instruction Primitive
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: System instructions are version-controlled configuration baselines; material permission-altering prompt changes require SCN evaluation (SCN-CSO-EVA).

components.title: Agent Input Handling
components.adr030_decision: D7, D8 (Sole Content Ingress Gate to Reasoning Core, Including Tool Metadata)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Screens untrusted context, retrieved documents, and remote MCP tools/list metadata before Reasoning Core ingestion across Class C and Class D.

components.title: Agent Output Handling
components.adr030_decision: D7, D8 (Sole Content Egress Gate from Reasoning Core)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Sanitizes structured tool-call proposals and rendered responses; strips Federal Customer Data from external telemetry across Class C and Class D.

components.title: Identity Provider
components.adr030_decision: D2, D9 (Identity Plane Trust Root & Subject-Attribute PIP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: CRITICAL ELEVATION: Class C requires NIST IAL2/AAL2/FAL2; Class D requires NIST IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 (CTL.IA.IA-05). Both classes require encrypted assertions (OIDC JWE or SAML XML-Enc) and local password bypass disabled.

components.title: Authorization Policy Decision Point
components.adr030_decision: D2, D9 (Central Policy Decision Point Consulted by All 4 PEPs & Model Serving)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Evaluates subject, tenant, and capability scope for all PEPs; Class D policy decisions incorporate AAL3/FAL3 hardware-backed assurance claims (CTL.IA.IA-05).

components.title: Agent Consent Elicitation Surface
components.adr030_decision: D5 (Mid-Loop Autonomous Agent Elicitation Surface)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Reserves mid-loop confirmation for irreversible/mutating actions and cryptographically binds approval digests; Class D requires AAL3/FAL3 non-repudiation context (CTL.IA.IA-05, CTL.AU.AU-10).

components.title: Isolation Runtime Boundary
components.adr030_decision: D3, D13 (Confinement Boundary Containing Runtime Hosting and Tool Hosting)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: MicroVM/gVisor/confidential-compute confinement boundary; note KSI-CNA-EIS and KSI-SVC-PRR define Class B/C in 2026.11.02.01 (Class D Rev5 enforced via CTL.SC.SC-07 and CTL.CP.CP-10-04).

components.title: Tool Server
components.adr030_decision: D1, D6 (Tool Server Endpoint, Capability Negotiation & Prompt-Template Locus)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Third-party MCP/tool servers are governed as TPIRs (MAS-CSO-TPR); Class D restricts federal-data tool servers to U.S. jurisdiction (CTL.SA.SA-09-05) and 2-day VDR triage (VER-TFR-EVU).

components.title: Agent Tool Transport Channel
components.adr030_decision: D1, D4 (Wire Channel Carrying JSON-RPC/MCP/gRPC Between Agent PEP and Tool PEP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Requires mutual TLS, session binding, and replay protection; Class D mandates active CMVP FIPS 140-3 modules on the transport channel (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

components.title: Authorization Federation Proxy
components.adr030_decision: D2, D17 (Cross-Domain Borrowed-Authority Intermediary Minting Scoped Tokens)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Performs RFC 8693 OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange across trust domains; Class D requires FAL3 assertion assurance and FIPS 140-3 signing/encryption modules (CTL.IA.IA-05, CMU-CSO-UVM).

components.title: Agent Network Policy Enforcement Point
components.adr030_decision: D4, D14 (Agent Operator Egress PEP Consulting IdP, PDP, and Tool Registry)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Default-deny outbound PEP consulting Tool Registry allowlist; Class D elevates FIPS-validated mTLS cryptography from SHOULD to MUST (CMU-CSO-UVM) and enforces U.S.-only destinations (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Authorization Policy Enforcement Point
components.adr030_decision: D1, D4 (In-Flow L7 Action Authorization PEP Between Tool Input Handling and Tool Server)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Enforces intersection of caller authority and agent capability token (preventing confused deputy); Class D requires upstream IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 identity assurance (CTL.IA.IA-05).

components.title: Tool Network Policy Enforcement Point
components.adr030_decision: D1, D4, D14 (Mandatory Resource-Side Network Ingress Gate to External Tool Zone)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: No data path may enter the External Tools tier without traversing this PEP (ADR-030 D14); Class D mandates FIPS 140-3 validated TLS/mTLS modules (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

components.title: Application Consent Surface
components.adr030_decision: D5 (User-Engaged Application Approval Locus)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Dual consent mode enforced across Class C and Class D; Class D binds high-consequence approvals to AAL3 session context (CTL.IA.IA-05).

components.title: Application Network Policy Enforcement Point
components.adr030_decision: D4 (Application Operator Egress PEP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Class D MUST enforce active FIPS 140-3 TLS/mTLS modules on application-to-agent handoff channels (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST vs Class C SHOULD).

components.title: Tool Hosting
components.adr030_decision: D3, D6, D13 (Third-Party Code Execution Substrate Inside Isolation Runtime)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Contains untrusted/third-party MCP and plugin code; Class D enforces 2-day VDR evaluation (VER-TFR-EVU) and U.S.-jurisdiction compute hosting (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

components.title: Runtime Hosting
components.adr030_decision: D3, D6, D13 (First-Party Execution Substrate Hosting Application, Reasoning Core, and Model Serving)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Persistent machine verification: 20x Class C MUST every 3 days (VDR-TFR-MVX, which omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01); Rev5 Class C & Class D MUST monthly (VDR-TFR-MVF); Class D VDR triage <= 2 days (VER-TFR-EVU).

components.title: Tool Input Handling
components.adr030_decision: D1, D7 (Tool-Boundary Inbound Argument Validation Before Authz PEP)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Validates JSON-RPC/tool schema arguments against coerced or injected parameters before Authorization PEP evaluation across Class C and Class D.

components.title: Tool Output Handling
components.adr030_decision: D1, D7 (Tool-Boundary Outbound Response Sanitization Against Tool Poisoning)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Screens outbound tool responses for indirect prompt injection, oversized payloads, and unauthorized sensitive-data leakage across Class C and Class D.

components.title: Audit Record Repository
components.adr030_decision: D3, D15 (Control-Plane-Separated Tamper-Evident WORM Audit Storage Sink)
components.class_c_vs_d_delta: Grounded in NIST SP 800-53 AU-9(2)/(4)/(6) control-plane separation; Class D mandates FIPS 140-3 cryptographic signing/encryption (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST) and U.S. residency (CTL.SA.SA-09-05). Note KSI-MLA-ALA omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01.

controls.title: Privacy Enhancing Technologies for Model Training
controls.class_c_enforcement: Required if training/evaluating with sensitive data; KSI-SVC-RUD applies to 20x Class C.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Strict prohibition on unapproved Federal Customer Data in training; U.S. jurisdiction mandatory (CTL.SA.SA-09-05); KSI-SVC-RUD pending 2027 for 20x Class D.

controls.title: Privacy Enhancing Technologies for Inference
controls.class_c_enforcement: MUST redact Federal Customer Data and raw prompts/responses before external telemetry emission (MAS-CSO-MDI).
controls.class_d_enforcement: MUST redact prior to any telemetry TPIR AND maintain all unredacted runtime audit logs inside U.S.-jurisdiction FIPS-encrypted WORM storage (CTL.SA.SA-09-05, CMU-CSO-UVM).

controls.title: Training Data Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Document training data inventory and security categories (MAS-CSO-FLO).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Enforce U.S./U.S. Territories/U.S. jurisdiction lineage and storage (CTL.SA.SA-09-05) plus per-service certification docs (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

controls.title: Training Data Sanitization
controls.class_c_enforcement: Sanitize untrusted training/fine-tuning inputs against poisoning (KSI-SCR-MIT, KSI-SVC-RUD).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same sanitization rigor plus mandatory supply-chain provenance controls under Rev5 High baseline (CTL.SR.SR-03).

controls.title: User Data Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Enforce agency retention, zero-training-by-default on Federal Customer Data, and tenant data deletion.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Add mandatory U.S. jurisdiction data/processing residency (CTL.SA.SA-09-05) and FIPS-validated encryption (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Model and Data Inventory Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Machine-readable inventory of all models, datasets, and metadata in MAS (MAS-CSO-IIR, MAS-CSO-MDI).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same machine-readable inventory plus mandatory per-service certification artifacts (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

controls.title: Model and Data Access Controls
controls.class_c_enforcement: Least-privilege RBAC/ABAC with NIST IAL2/AAL2/FAL2 authentication (CTL.IA.IA-05).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Elevates privileged & user access to NIST IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 hardware-backed authentication (CTL.IA.IA-05).

controls.title: Model and Data Integrity Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Cryptographic digest/signature verification of weights and artifacts; FIPS modules SHOULD be used (CMU-CSO-UVM).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Cryptographic signatures MUST use active CMVP FIPS 140-3 validated modules (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Model and Data Execution Integrity
controls.class_c_enforcement: Immutable container/model digests verified at inference startup; KSI-CNA-EIS applies to 20x Class C.
controls.class_d_enforcement: FIPS 140-3 signature verification at runtime load (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST); KSI-CNA-EIS omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01 (enforced via Rev5 CTL.CM.CM-14).

controls.title: Secure-by-Default ML Tooling
controls.class_c_enforcement: Safe tensor loaders (safetensors over pickle), default-deny network egress, and SCG secure defaults (SCG-CSO-SDF).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same secure-by-default baseline plus 2-day vulnerability evaluation SLA on ML tooling CVEs (VER-TFR-EVU).

controls.title: Input Validation and Sanitization
controls.class_c_enforcement: Multi-layer structural/semantic validation across Application, Agent, Orchestration, and Tool input gates.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same multi-layer validation with heightened monitoring under CTL.SI.SI-04-02 / CTL.SI.SI-04-05.

controls.title: Output Validation and Sanitization
controls.class_c_enforcement: Sanitize Markdown/HTML/JSON outputs and tool responses to block XSS, SSRF, and covert exfiltration.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same sanitization plus strict U.S.-boundary egress enforcement preventing cross-jurisdiction data leakage (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

controls.title: Adversarial Training and Testing
controls.class_c_enforcement: Pre-deployment adversarial prompt-injection and jailbreak evaluation suites.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Mandatory independent penetration/red-team validation evidence in per-service certification package (CTL.CA.CA-08, CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

controls.title: Application Access and Resource Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: IAL2/AAL2/FAL2 SSO with encrypted assertions, rate quotas, and local password bypass disabled (CTL.IA.IA-05).
controls.class_d_enforcement: IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 phishing-resistant hardware-backed SSO with encrypted assertions (CTL.IA.IA-05).

controls.title: User Transparency and Controls
controls.class_c_enforcement: Clear customer use instructions (SCG-CSO-AUP) and attribution of AI-generated actions.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Per-service public and controlled documentation of autonomous agent capabilities (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST, SCG-CSO-AUP).

controls.title: Agent User Control
controls.class_c_enforcement: Dual consent surfaces (Application + Agent Elicitation) gating state-mutating or external actions.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Dual consent surfaces bound to IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 authenticated sessions with non-repudiable audit records (CTL.IA.IA-05, CTL.AU.AU-10).

controls.title: Agent Permissions
controls.class_c_enforcement: Least-privilege tool allowlists and caller-intersection delegation checks at Authorization PEP.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same strict intersection delegation with hardware-attested FAL3 assertions and short-lived capability tokens (CTL.IA.IA-05).

controls.title: Red Teaming
controls.class_c_enforcement: Structured adversarial red-teaming of prompt injection, confused deputy, and tool boundary bypasses (CTL.CA.CA-08).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Annual independent assessment + red-team exercises across per-service high-impact agent boundaries (IVV-CSO-FIA, CTL.CA.CA-08).

controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Evaluate vulnerabilities within <= 5 days (VER-TFR-EVU); PAIN=5 IRV+LEV remediated in 2 days (VDR-TFR-PVR); non-IRV PAIN=5 LEV incident escalation is MAY (VER-TFR-NRI).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Evaluate vulnerabilities within <= 2 days (VER-TFR-EVU); PAIN=5 IRV+LEV remediated in 12 hours (VDR-TFR-PVR); non-IRV PAIN=5 LEV incident escalation elevates to SHOULD (VER-TFR-NRI).

controls.title: Threat Detection
controls.class_c_enforcement: Automated SIEM correlation over agent tool anomalies, delegation failures, and egress blocks (KSI-MLA-OSM, KSI-IAM-SUS).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Real-time automated alerting and anomaly correlation integrated with 2-day VDR/IEC escalation pipelines (CTL.SI.SI-04-02, VER-TFR-NRI SHOULD).

controls.title: Incident Response Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Default PAIN=5 unless promptly rated (IEC-CSO-DPR); mandatory IIR/OIR/FIR notifications to FedRAMP and affected agencies.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same mandatory IIR/OIR/FIR plus SHOULD escalate non-internet-reachable PAIN=5 LEVs as FedRAMP Reportable Incidents (VER-TFR-NRI) and execute immediate kill-switch containment.

controls.title: User Policies and Education
controls.class_c_enforcement: Publish agency customer acceptable-use and secure configuration guidance (SCG-CSO-AUP, SCG-CSO-PUB).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Supply per-service customer configuration and usage policies in Trust Center (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST, CDS-CSO-IRP).

controls.title: Internal Policies and Education
controls.class_c_enforcement: Role-based AI security, prompt-injection, and incident-response training for engineering and operations personnel (KSI-CED-RAT).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Enhanced privileged-operator training and U.S.-jurisdiction personnel access controls where required (KSI-CED-RAT, CTL.IR.IR-02-02, CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

controls.title: Product Governance
controls.class_c_enforcement: Named accountable official (FRC-CSO-MRA), SCN governance (SCN-CSO-EVA), and optional per-service materials (CDS-CSO-PSM MAY).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Mandatory per-service FedRAMP Certification materials (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST) and quarterly CCM reviews (CCM-QTR-MTG MUST).

controls.title: Risk Governance
controls.class_c_enforcement: Persistent Security Decision Record (SDR-CSO-FRR), quarterly reviews (CCM-QTR-MTG MUST), and 20x daily/30d/1yr KSI metrics (SDR-CSX-KMT MUST).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same Rev5/common SDR rigor; note SDR-CSX-KMT states 20x Class D MUST significantly supersede lower classes with specifics set in the 20x Phase 4 Pilot.

controls.title: Agent Observability
controls.class_c_enforcement: Structured delegation, tool-call, and PEP verdict logs written to separated tamper-evident repository; KSI-MLA-ALA applies to 20x Class C.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Adds FIPS 140-3 signed/encrypted audit trails (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST) and U.S. residency (CTL.SA.SA-09-05); KSI-MLA-ALA omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01.

controls.title: Isolated and Confidential Computing
controls.class_c_enforcement: Hardware/hypervisor isolation for multi-tenant inference and third-party tool sandboxes (third_party_tool_isolation=true).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Dedicated U.S.-jurisdiction sovereign compute / confidential enclaves mitigating cross-tenant side channels for High-impact workloads (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

controls.title: Retrieval and Vector System Integrity Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Provenance-verified ingestion, tenant-isolated vector namespaces, and pre-retrieval ACL filtering.
controls.class_d_enforcement: FIPS 140-3 encrypted vector indices (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST) hosted strictly within U.S. jurisdiction (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

controls.title: Orchestrator and Route Integrity
controls.class_c_enforcement: Cryptographically pinned routing configuration enforced by Model Serving PEP to approved certified TPIR endpoints.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Fail-closed U.S.-jurisdiction-only model routing (us_jurisdiction_only=true per CTL.SA.SA-09-05); route table edits require SCN evaluation.

controls.title: Agent Inventory Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Every agent registered via canonical agent-manifest.json before credential issuance; unregistered shadow agents blocked at PEPs.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Same pre-issuance registration plus mandatory per-service certification artifacts in Trust Center (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

controls.title: Agent Integrity Management
controls.class_c_enforcement: Cryptographically bind agent workload identity to manifest/model digest; revoke credentials automatically on model swap.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Cryptographic identity-to-artifact bindings signed using active CMVP FIPS 140-3 modules (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Agent Credential Isolation
controls.class_c_enforcement: Per-tenant, short-lived capability tokens with zero cross-tenant credential pools; validated at every MCP/tool hop.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Tokens minted under FAL3/AAL3 assurance and protected with FIPS 140-3 cryptographic modules (CTL.IA.IA-05, CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Inter-Component Transport Security
controls.class_c_enforcement: mTLS 1.2+/1.3 across all inter-component paths (including localhost MCP servers), channel-bound tokens, and replay nonces; FIPS SHOULD (CMU-CSO-UVM).
controls.class_d_enforcement: Active CMVP FIPS 140-3 validated TLS/mTLS cryptographic modules are MANDATORY across every inter-component wire (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Component Identity Provenance
controls.class_c_enforcement: Runtime SPIFFE/SVID or short-lived registry-gated attestation verifying callee is the active non-revoked principal at invocation time.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Provenance attestations backed by FIPS 140-3 HSM/KMS roots of trust (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

controls.title: Agent Execution Bounds
controls.class_c_enforcement: Mandatory max_turns, tool-call budgets, context-window ceilings, and loop-detection circuit breakers.
controls.class_d_enforcement: Strict deterministic execution ceilings protecting High-availability mission workloads (CDS-CSO-AVR MUST, KSI-CNA-OFA).

controls.title: Model Registry and Discovery Integrity
controls.class_c_enforcement: Signed model registry entries with digest pinning consulted by Model Serving PEP.
controls.class_d_enforcement: FIPS 140-3 signature verification on registry manifests and U.S.-jurisdiction artifact hosting (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST, CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

controls.title: Tool Registry and Discovery Integrity
controls.class_c_enforcement: Signed MCP/tool manifests, schema hash pinning, anti-shadowing checks, and egress PEP allowlist enforcement.
controls.class_d_enforcement: FIPS 140-3 signed tool descriptors (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST), 2-day CVE/tampering triage (VER-TFR-EVU), and U.S. residency for federal-data tools.

risks.title: Data Poisoning
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Compromised integrity of Federal outputs triggers IEC-CSO-EFR reportability; Class D requires 2-day evaluation (VER-TFR-EVU).

risks.title: Unauthorized Training Data
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Unauthorized ingestion of Federal Customer Data into training is a reportable confidentiality/integrity incident (IEC-CSO-EFR) and violates Class D U.S. residency if offshored (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

risks.title: Model Source Tampering
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Class D mandates FIPS 140-3 signature verification on model artifacts (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST) and 2-day VDR triage (VER-TFR-EVU).

risks.title: Excessive Data Handling
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Any component handling excessive Federal Customer Data or metadata is pulled into MAS (MAS-CSO-IIR, MAS-CSO-MDI); Class D adds per-service certification burden (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

risks.title: Excessive Data Handling During Inference
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Leaking inference prompts/responses to external telemetry or non-certified TPIRs fails validate_manifest.py; Class D enforces strict U.S. jurisdiction (CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

risks.title: Model Exfiltration
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Prevented by ADR-030 D11 reachability boundary (model_reachability_pep=true) and Class D FIPS 140-3 storage/transport encryption (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

risks.title: Model Deployment Tampering
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Detected via persistent drift detection (VDR-TFR-PDD) and immutable redeployment (KSI-CMT-RMV); Class D evaluates findings within <= 2 days (VER-TFR-EVU).

risks.title: Denial of ML Service
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Both Class C and Class D MUST report availability metrics (CDS-CSO-AVR); High-impact Class D systems carry stricter mission continuity SLAs (CTL.CP.CP-02-03).

risks.title: Model Reverse Engineering
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mitigated via query rate limiting at Model Serving PEP and SIEM extraction-pattern alerting; heightened impact if fine-tuned on agency data.

risks.title: Insecure Integrated Component
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Class C <= 5d vs Class D <= 2d triage (VER-TFR-EVU); Class D PAIN=5 IRV+LEV remediation is 12 hours vs Class C 2 days (VDR-TFR-PVR); Class D VER-TFR-NRI elevates to SHOULD.

risks.title: Prompt Injection
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Contained architecturally via Agent Input Handling, Authorization PEP, and Dual Consent Surfaces; compromises affecting Federal data trigger IEC-CSO-EFR.

risks.title: Model Evasion
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Tested via portable evals and red-teaming (CTL.CA.CA-08); high-consequence tool actions remain gated by deterministic Authorization PEP regardless of model evasion.

risks.title: Sensitive Data Disclosure
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Any disclosure of Federal Customer Data is a mandatory FedRAMP Reportable Incident (IEC-CSO-EFR, default PAIN=5 per IEC-CSO-DPR) requiring spillage response (CTL.IR.IR-09).

risks.title: Inferred Sensitive Data
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Pre-retrieval RBAC/ABAC and tenant context isolation prevent cross-record inference; Class D High categorization elevates spillage severity.

risks.title: Insecure Model Output
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Unsanitized markdown/code output executing in agency browsers or CI runners is mitigated by Agent/Application Output Handling and strict CSP/egress PEPs.

risks.title: Rogue Actions
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Blocked by Authorization PEP, allowed_tools allowlist, and Dual Consent Surfaces (consent_surface_dual_mode=true); Class D binds approvals to IAL3/AAL3/FAL3.

risks.title: Accelerator and System Side-channels
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Class D High workloads require dedicated U.S.-jurisdiction sovereign GPU/compute isolation or confidential enclaves (third_party_tool_isolation=true, CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

risks.title: Economic Denial of Wallet
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mitigated by token/cost quotas at Application Access Management and max_turns circuit breakers in Agent Execution Bounds.

risks.title: Federated/Distributed Training Privacy
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Cross-boundary gradient sharing prohibited unless inside MAS or certified TPIRs with Class D FIPS 140-3 encryption and U.S. residency.

risks.title: Adapter/PEFT Injection
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: LoRA/PEFT adapters must be cryptographically signed in Model Registry; Class D mandates FIPS 140-3 signature validation at Model Serving PEP (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

risks.title: Tool Registry Tampering
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mitigated by tool_registry_allowlist=true and signed tool schemas; Class D enforces FIPS 140-3 manifest signatures and 2-day VDR triage.

risks.title: Orchestrator/Route Hijack
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Route hijacking to non-certified or non-U.S. inference endpoints violates MAS-CSO-TPR and Class D CTL.SA.SA-09-05; blocked by model_reachability_pep=true.

risks.title: Evaluation/Benchmark Manipulation
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mitigated by SHA-256 artifact_digests in evidence-bundle.schema.json and CoSAI ADR-033 D7d clean separation of fixtures from grader expectations.

risks.title: Covert Channels in Model Outputs
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Contained by default-deny Agent/Application Network PEPs blocking arbitrary external URL rendering or unapproved callback egress.

risks.title: Malicious Loader/Deserialization
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Prohibit unsafe pickle/code-executing model loaders; Class D requires <= 2-day evaluation (VER-TFR-EVU) and 12h PAIN=5 IRV+LEV mitigation (VDR-TFR-PVR).

risks.title: Tool Source Provenance
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Unvetted MCP/tool servers prohibited; every external tool dependency requires MAS-CSO-TPR documentation, tool_registry_allowlist=true, and Class D U.S. residency.

risks.title: Prompt/Response Cache Poisoning
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Semantic/KV caches MUST partition cache keys cryptographically by agency tenant ID and caller authorization scope across Class C and Class D.

risks.title: Retrieval/Vector Store Poisoning
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mitigated via authenticated RAG ingestion pipelines, Agent Input Handling screening of retrieved chunks, and tenant-isolated vector indices.

risks.title: Agent Delegation Chain Opacity
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Eliminated by logging structured correlation/delegation-chain spans at every PEP hop into separated tamper-evident Audit Record Repository (tamper_evident_audit_repo=true).

risks.title: Stale Agent Identity Binding
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Agent workload identities bind to manifest + model artifact digest and auto-revoke on model swap; Class D binds via FIPS 140-3 modules (CMU-CSO-UVM MUST).

risks.title: MCP Transport Hijacking
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Mandates mTLS, origin validation, and channel-bound tokens on Agent Tool Transport; Class D elevates FIPS 140-3 cryptographic modules from SHOULD to MUST (CMU-CSO-UVM).

risks.title: Shadow and Unknown Agents
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Unregistered agents without a valid agent-manifest.json and registry-issued identity are blocked by Network and Model Serving PEPs; Class D requires per-service CDS artifacts (CDS-CSO-PSM MUST).

risks.title: Runaway Agent Tool Loops
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Halted by mandatory max_turns, per-session tool budgets, and circuit breakers enforced before Authorization PEP dispatch.

risks.title: Agentic Delegation Confused Deputy
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Prevented by authorization_pep=true enforcing RFC 8693 audience/scope intersection of caller + deputy; Class D requires IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 caller assertions (CTL.IA.IA-05).

risks.title: Cross-Tenant Credential Propagation
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Prevented by per-tenant token issuance and Federation Proxy tenant-claim validation; cross-tenant leakage is a catastrophic PAIN=5 FedRAMP Reportable Incident (IEC-CSO-DPR).

risks.title: Zombie / Shadow MCP Servers
risks.class_c_vs_d_elevation: Eliminated by tool_registry_allowlist=true at Agent Network PEP plus Component Identity Provenance revocation checks at invocation time.

personas.title: Model Provider
personas.responsibility_summary: Supplies foundation or fine-tuned model weights/endpoints; when external to the CSO MAS, governed under MAS-CSO-TPR (certified TPIR preferred; U.S. jurisdiction mandatory for Class D per CTL.SA.SA-09-05).

personas.title: Data Provider
personas.responsibility_summary: Supplies Federal Customer Data (FRD-FCD), retrieval corpora, or evaluation datasets; governs security categorization (FIPS 199 Moderate/Class C vs High/Class D) and residency constraints.

personas.title: AI Platform Provider
personas.responsibility_summary: Operates underlying cloud hosting, Isolation Runtime, KMS/HSM, network PEPs, and WORM Audit Record Repository (e.g., inherited FedRAMP High sovereign cloud in Class D).

personas.title: AI Model Serving
personas.responsibility_summary: Operates Model Serving Infrastructure & Policy Enforcement Point (componentModelServing), enforcing model reachability (ADR-030 D11/D12), FIPS mTLS, and Class D U.S.-only inference processing.

personas.title: Agentic Platform and Framework Providers
personas.responsibility_summary: Supplies orchestration/agentic runtime libraries, MCP transports, and execution-bound enforcement; subject to 5-day (Class C) or 2-day (Class D) VDR evaluation SLAs.

personas.title: Application Developer
personas.responsibility_summary: Clones/branches this standard repository, authors agent-manifest.json, wires PEPs and dual consent surfaces, maintains portable evals, and publishes SCN/SDR/CDS artifacts.

personas.title: AI System Governance
personas.responsibility_summary: Named Responsible/Accountable Official, compliance reviewers, and 3PAO/IVV assessors governing SDR decisions, Trust Center releases, quarterly reviews, and incident reportability.

personas.title: AI System Users
personas.responsibility_summary: Federal agency personnel and mission operators authenticating via IAL2/AAL2/FAL2 (Class C) or IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 (Class D) SSO and exercising Application/Agent Consent Surfaces.

personas.title: Model Creator (Legacy)
personas.responsibility_summary: DEPRECATED in CoSAI Risk Map (superseded by personaModelProvider and personaApplicationDeveloper); retained in crosswalk for full 10-persona schema completeness.

personas.title: Model Consumer (Legacy)
personas.responsibility_summary: DEPRECATED in CoSAI Risk Map (superseded by personaApplicationDeveloper and personaEndUser); retained in crosswalk for full 10-persona schema completeness.
